integrity_note: An exact independent audit has not been performed; the mathematical proof and standalone checking scripts were reviewed within the same research preparation.
scientific_limitations: Exact theorem is restricted to synchronous strict majority on GP(n,2) for n at least five, and does not classify two-cycles or transients.
The all-size result rests on a finite transfer-matrix reduction with computationally reproducible exact integer and symbolic certificates, not on checking finitely many graph sizes.
Historical priority remains conditional on unindexed or unavailable special-purpose matching-cut enumerations.
title: Ninth-degree spin sectors and an entropy gap in majority dynamics on generalized Petersen graphs
